_comment: T138 ⟨R1⟩ — the ONE shared 'default file' rule, expressed once and run in both lanes so it cannot
drift. defaultFile(files) -> the filename the STAGE takes for a member who has chosen nothing, or
none. Go (core/internal/app) and TS (web/studio) each run this whole set; ci.yml diffs the mirrored
copy (app-side mirror at web/studio/test/default-file.vectors.json) so the two files stay identical.
RULE: among the pool's files whose contentType is "application/pdf", take the one with the lowest
displayOrder; break a tie by filename (ascending). No PDF -> none.
PDF-vs-image, settled here (the spec left it to whoever wrote the vectors): the default is PDF-ONLY.
The baker rasterizes with poppler, which bakes PDFs, not images — so an image cannot be the file the
stage takes. Studio's VIEWER still opens images for browsing; that is a different question (view vs
bake) and is exactly the line T138 draws. So an image-only song has NO default: Studio and the baker
now AGREE it is unbakeable rather than one silently picking it (the case that failed before T138).
Values are hand-derived from the rule, not emitted by either impl, so an off-by-one fails red-first.
Each file is {filename, contentType, displayOrder}; expected is the filename or null.

cases.name: mixed: the image is lower but skipped for the PDF
